## Checklist

- [ ] `vp check`, `node scripts/guard.ts`, `node scripts/gates.ts`, `vp test`, `vp run build` and `vp run test:browser` pass
- [ ] A changed component's example and docs page change with it
- [ ] Nothing a product knows: no Grasp concepts, product copy or Lingui in `src`
- [ ] No secrets, client names or internal notes
